script.text: Good morning! I'm Kelly, and this is your daily lesson for November 17. Today we're exploring two powerful ideas together.

Where does your responsibility end and someone else's begin?  What are you willing to accept and what crosses a line?  Boundaries are the edges of you—defining what's yours to give and what's yours to protect.

Boundaries exist in many domains: physical, emotional, time, energy, information. Each requires different limits. Knowing your boundaries in each area creates comprehensive protection. Boundaries work when communicated.  Unexpressed limits get crossed innocently.
Today's wisdom: Here's today's wisdom: Healthy relationships require healthy boundaries.  Knowing your limits enables genuine connection.
Now let's take what we learned and put it into practice.
Today's growth challenge is Boundary Mapping - Where Are Your Edges?.

Here's your activity: Map your boundaries in key areas: time, energy, physical space, emotional sharing, information. Where are they firm? Where are they porous? What boundary, if strengthened, would most improve your wellbeing? This helps you identify and strengthen personal boundaries.
And here's how today's lessons connect: What you learned about where you end and others begin can be applied to boundary mapping - where are your edges?. Practice makes progress.
That's today's lesson. Learn something, grow a little. I'll see you tomorrow with something new. Stay curious!
